### Install
Download **Lindale-setup.exe** below and run it. If Windows SmartScreen says *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info → Run anyway** (the installer is not code-signed yet).

Prefer no installer? Download **Lindale-portable.zip**, extract it anywhere and run `Lindale.exe`.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/supdocquart/Lindale/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what changed.
